subject: Exception condition handling
notes: LANDED 2026-08-18 (PB66 + its sweep). Under >>TURN EC-DATA-INCOMPATIBLE CHECKING ON a de-editing MOVE from content that is not a possible result of editing raises the (fatal, Table 13) exception before the receiver is written: the floating-point form validates position by position (a non-digit digit position, a wrong insertion character, a missing E or exponent sign — '1.23E+X' planted through a REDEFINES); the FIXED-POINT form verifies the round trip Format(DeEdit(image)) == image (Format IS the one editor, so the test is exact — ' 12.50' and a BLANK WHEN ZERO all-spaces zero pass, 'AB.CDE' raises). With checking off the digit positions are read (a non-digit contributes zero) — the standard's 'undefined' result, CONFORMANCE.md §3.
